title: Theatre, B.F.A. -- Stage Management Option (College of Arts and Architecture)
notes: Stage Management Option (of six: five Design and Technology emphases -- Costume, Scene, Lighting, Sound, Scenic Technology -- plus Stage Management; Stage Management chosen since its plan and course list are the most self-contained and cleanest to verify). Entrance requires a faculty interview and production book review, not modeled directly. Greatly extended thea_catalog.json with 21 more courses. Real data artifacts found and fixed via direct department-PDF verification: the bulletin's own approved-electives footnote for the final-semester elective typos 'THEA 405Y' (real course: THEA 405W), 'THEA 407' (real: THEA 407W), and 'THEA 408' (real: THEA 408W); 'THEA 406' referenced in the same footnote does not exist at all and was dropped. 'THEA 200', listed in the Suggested Academic Plan's own First Year Spring semester, could not be confirmed to exist anywhere in the department's course catalog (not hyperlinked in the bulletin's own HTML, absent from the official course-description PDF between THEA 199 and THEA 201W) -- treated as a stale bulletin data artifact and replaced with a generic Gen Ed slot rather than guessed at. Real gap fixed: THEA 270 strictly requires THEA 201W and THEA 252, neither of which the Stage Management plan otherwise schedules -- added both as explicit Semester 4 items. THEA 289 (max 3cr across repeats), THEA 486 (max 12cr across repeats, scheduled 3x = 9cr), and THEA 496 (1-18cr, scheduled 2x) are each modeled with one literal pick and the remaining occurrences as generic repeat slots, matching the WFED 395/ARCH 491 repeatable-course convention. Several semesters' bulletin-stated credit totals didn't fully reconcile against their itemized course lists (a recurring minor source-summarization gap this session, e.g. Landscape Architecture/Digital Arts and Media Design) -- closed with generic Gen Ed padding rather than forced precision. 2026-08-27 re-verification against the live bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan tab HTML (fetched directly via DOM, not the summarized program page -- this page bundles all six options behind one tab, so the Stage Management table was located by its own heading text): confirmed Semesters 1-6 already matched exactly. Found and fixed two real bugs in Semesters 7-8: (1) THEA 496 was modeled at 1cr in both its appearances, but the real plan schedules it at 3cr both times (Fourth Year Fall and Spring) -- fixed both. (2) Semester 7's Gen Ed was lumped into one 3.5cr generic slot and Semester 8 had a phantom plain 3cr Gen Ed with no real basis plus a wrong 2.5cr Gen Ed -- the real plan actually splits a 3cr GHW requirement into two 1.5cr installments, one each in Fourth Year Fall and Spring (alongside a separate plain 3cr Gen Ed only in Fall), and Fourth Year Spring's real last item is a 2cr Elective, not Gen Ed at all -- rebuilt both semesters' item lists to match exactly (Semester 7 now: THEA486 repeat, THEA 496(3), Additional-Course-for-Option, Elective, plain GEN ED, GEN ED (GHW) 1.5cr = 16.5cr; Semester 8 now: THEA 481, THEA 486 repeat, THEA 496 repeat(3), GEN ED (GHW) 1.5cr, Elective(2) = 12.5cr), both totals now matching the bulletin exactly.
